findings.issue: הוּנַף and הוּרָם are hophal perfect 3rd masculine singular, matching the masculine breast (חזה). The feminine participles make pierna/ofrenda the item waved and raised and leave pecho outside those clauses.
findings.spanishSpan: que fue balanceada y que fue alzada

findings.issue: שׁוֹק is the thigh/shank (feminine singular construct). pierna names the whole leg.

notes: Tú future, hophal passive, plural fillings, and the repeated min-relatives match the tokens.
